name: get_domain_price
description:
Get price data for a specific domain for a given number of years; defaults to the TLD's minimum term. This is a read-only lookup and does not purchase the domain.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} domains price {domain}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

years.description: The number of years to get the price for. If not provided, the minimum number of years for the TLD will be used.
